title: Dungeon Escape Horde
description: Battle through dark crypts swarming with skeletons and slimes—stack roguelike skill combos, evolve devastating weapons, and fight your way out of the dungeon.
controls: Drag to dodge monster packs while auto-firing spells and selecting roguelike skill upgrades on level-up.

zh-CN.title: 逃出地下城割草
zh-CN.description: 暗黑像素肉鸽割草逃出地下城：孤身勇闯怪物狂潮地牢，拾取经验升级叠满超武神技，杀出血路逃出生天！
zh-CN.controls: 单指拖动控制走位躲避怪群，角色自动释放技能并在升级时三选一强化大招。
